column2: Accuracy on the training clips at the epoch whose weights were kept, measured during training with random horizontal flips. Classical models (D): accuracy of the fitted model on the training clips. Fusion models (E03, F03) have no training of their own: their train score is the accuracy on the training clips of the two member models' averaged outputs.
Accuracy on the validation clips. Every model choice (early stopping, kept weights, fusion members) was made on validation only.
Scored once per model and held out until the final model is selected, so that the reported test result is unbiased. B01's test result is shown because it reproduces the published baseline.
In the spreadsheet version, the best validation score within each family is shown in bold.
Each model was trained once (one random seed). Differences of less than about 1.5 points between two models are within run-to-run variation.
Clips in which no batter could be detected (about 2%) are excluded by every model.
All numbers come from the project's experiment records: the results ledger and each run's validation report and training history.
